## Problem and behavior

What concrete case does this fix? What changes for the user?

## Validation

List the regression test and checks run. Use synthetic fixtures; do not attach
media, credentials, signed URLs, private config, or raw service logs.

## Safety and compatibility

Does this change preview/apply, verification, backups, CLI behavior, or config?
Explain any migration needed. Keep verification thresholds unchanged unless the
change has independent evidence and focused tests.
